title: Abonten: Events & Tickets
shortDescription: Find events and places in Ghana, get tickets, and host your own events.
fullDescription:
Abonten is where you find out what's happening around you in Ghana, get a ticket, and go.

FIND IT
• See events near you by category, by date or on the map.
• Search events, places and organizers by name.
• Save the events you like and follow the organizers and places behind them.

GET IN
• Reserve a free spot or buy a ticket in a few taps.
• Pay with mobile money or card. The full price, service fee included, is shown before you pay.
• Your ticket and its QR code stay on your phone.

GO
• Get directions to the venue and a reminder before it starts.
• Show your code at the door.
• Afterwards, review the events and places you went to.

FOR EVENT ORGANIZERS
• Publish an event in minutes: flyer, dates, venue and ticket types.
• Keep 100% of the ticket price you set. Buyers pay the service fee on top.
• Check guests in by scanning their tickets with your phone.
• Follow your sales, create promo codes and answer questions from guests.

FOR PLACES
• List your restaurant, bar, club or venue with photos, opening hours and services.
• Receive booking requests, and reply to reviews and messages.

AND MORE
• Spotlight: short videos from events and places.
• Messages: ask an organizer or a place a question before you go.
• In English, French, Spanish, German and Portuguese.

Abɔnten is Twi for "outside". Go outside.

Abonten is made in Ghana by Abonten Hub Ltd. Payments are processed by Paystack.
